title: Dual battery charging system
goal: Show alternator charging of a starter battery and an isolated auxiliary battery supply.

rubric.must: A labelled alternator rated 14.4 VDC and 120 A is visible.
The alternator output passes through a visible 150 A fuse to the starter battery.
A voltage-sensitive split-charge relay is visibly placed between the starter and auxiliary battery feeds.
A 200 A auxiliary battery isolator switch is shown downstream of the split-charge relay.
The auxiliary battery feeds auxiliary loads through a clearly labelled 80 A fuse.
Both batteries and the auxiliary load visibly share a chassis earth return.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. Alternator and starter battery on the fused main, the voltage-sensitive relay and isolator between the two batteries, and the auxiliary loads fused separately, all returning on the chassis.
